name: 90 Day: The Last Resort
description: In a final attempt to salvage their relationships, previous couples from the 90 Day Fiancé universe will participate in a couples retreat to determine whether or not they can heal old wounds

videos.title: The Last Chance (1)
videos.overview: Five 90 Day couples arrive at a paradise retreat for intensive therapy. Infidelity shakes Kalani and Asuelu's world. Angela threatens divorce. Yara confronts her nemesis. Ed and Liz want to move beyond their breakup cycle. Molly and Kelly try to heal.

videos.title: The Last Chance (2)
videos.overview: A blindfolded obstacle course puts relationships to the test. Angela communicates better with another man than with Michael. Yara reveals a secret she's been keeping from Jovi. Ed gets called out for cheating during a trust-based challenge.

videos.title: One Last Time
videos.overview: Liz triggers Angela, who ends up having to discuss her anger issues with Dr. Janie. Yara's romantic gesture ends with a drunken debacle. Liz and Ed struggle to communicate. Kalani and Asuelu take a shaky step forward. Molly and Kelly fall into old habits.

videos.title: How Long Do You Last?
videos.overview: Sex therapy exposes the couples' intimate vulnerabilities. Angela and Michael find a new way to enjoy their long distance relationship. Jovi and Yara struggle to get on the same page. Molly and Kelly seem to reach an impasse.

videos.title: Last Call
videos.overview: The couples talk about failing and succeeding at their sex therapy homework. Jovi plans a surprising experience for Asuelu. Angela scares Kalani and Yara with what's hidden in her swimsuit. Ed discovers who he was in a past life.

videos.title: Last Licks
videos.overview: Kalani, Yara, Angela and Liz bond at a lingerie party, and Yara talks about her insecurities. Ed demonstrates one of his intimate skills. Kama Sutra therapy pushes one couple to their breaking point. Kalani reveals why she can't forgive Asuelu.

videos.title: Last Life
videos.overview: Past lives reveal present issues for Ed and Liz. A pool party brings one couple closer together and tears another couple apart. Michael and Angela both break down in therapy.

videos.title: One Last Secret
videos.overview: Family therapy exposes Kalani and Asuelu's secrets. Molly and Kelly reach an impasse. Jovi and Yara discuss their intimacy. Angela surprises Michael for their anniversary. Ed reveals a secret that puts Liz in a tough position.

videos.title: Where Did You Go Last Night?
videos.overview: Family therapy reveals that Yara isn't the only one keeping secrets. The couples find out what Molly has been up to. Kalani's absence has Asuelu freaking out. The girls find out the truth about Kalani.

videos.title: Last Chance Saloon
videos.overview: Kalani comes clean to the girls about her night off the resort. Jovi and Ed bring Asuelu to his first strip club and get Michael in trouble. Jovi's actions have Yara questioning their relationship.

videos.title: That Last Text
videos.overview: Kalani tells Asuelu the truth about her night off the resort. A sunset cruise causes setbacks for multiple couples just a day before the commitment ceremony. Ed tells Yara about a text Jovi sent. A fight breaks out on the high seas.

videos.title: The Last Walk
videos.overview: Fallout from the strip club and the boat threatens relationships on the eve of the commitment ceremony. The final group session reveals further setbacks. The couples decide whether to recommit or separate as the retreat comes to an end.

videos.title: Built To Last?
videos.overview: 90 DAY FIANCÉ couples Ari & Bini, Brandon & Julia, Gino & Jasmine, Rob & Sophie, Josh & Natalie and Stacey & Florian have all reached their relationship breaking points. The six couples will spend three weeks at a desert oasis in Arizona, where they will undergo a rigorous relationship bootcamp aimed at rebuilding trust and connections.

videos.title: The Last Straw
videos.overview: The couples head to the desert for a group therapy called "Compromise Canyon." They carry rocks that represent their issues and need to lighten their loads by hashing it out. When Gino and Jasmine get into a huge fight, Jasmine calls a friend for support.

videos.title: Save The Last Dance
videos.overview: The couples head to a club to let off some steam and things get heated as they let loose. Ari goes missing. Natalie discovers Josh has been messaging Sophie, and Natalie decides to take action.

videos.title: The Last Word
videos.overview: Natalie gets to the root of her issues when Josh leaves the resort. Sex therapy exposes truths and reveals secret fantasies that bring some couples together and divides others. Jasmine opens up about a solution she has for her and Gino's sexless marriage.

videos.title: The Last Rodeo
videos.overview: Jasmine's open marriage suggestion shuts Gino down. Sex therapy homework fails to break the sexual gridlock, and leaves most of the couples unsatisfied. Natalie confronts the ladies about her huge club blowout and asks for forgiveness. The guys bond but tempers flare when the ladies crash their party.

videos.title: The Last Laugh
videos.overview: Tempers continue to flare after a night of excessive partying. A kayaking activity challenges power dynamics. Some couples manage to work as teams while others fall into old behaviors, as not all can respect the rules.

videos.title: If You're Not First, You're Last
videos.overview: Julia reveals a painful secret that affects her marriage with Brandon. Ari's peace offering doesn't have the intended results with Bini. Gino's rejection has Jasmine at a breaking point. Sex therapy reveals intimacy issues with Natalie and Josh.

videos.title: Last Minute Invitation
videos.overview: Sandbox therapy leaves Sophie and Rob feeling vulnerable. Brandon hopes the honeymoon suite will bring romance with Julia, but she plans a big party instead. Florian's anger gets the best of him. Natalie isn't sure if Josh is still at the resort.

videos.title: Nice Guys Finish Last
videos.overview: The couples try to help Gino and Jasmine reconnect, but they're at a crossroads. Camping brings everyone outdoors and hypnotherapy gets them out of their comfort zones. Julia reveals a secret that puts her relationship with Brandon in jeopardy.

videos.title: Lasting Effects
videos.overview: Past drama brings up present issues in therapy. Brandon has doubts if he and Julia can move forward. Jasmine fears that Gino is keeping a secret that will ruin them. Sophie discovers Rob is hiding something from her and is in complete shock.

videos.title: Last Blow
videos.overview: The trip into the desert becomes a scorcher. Sophie and Rob come to blows over alleged cheating. Julia and Brandon struggle to reconnect after her confession. Natalie calls Josh out for body shaming. Ari is pushed to her breaking point by the others.

videos.title: On Their Last Legs
videos.overview: The couples struggle to reconnect after camping therapy. Gino and Jasmine are at an intimacy stalemate. Ari fears her relationship with Bini is over. Jasmine introduces the ladies to her open marriage candidate. Darcey brings trouble for Stacey and Florian.

videos.title: The Last Judgment
videos.overview: The couples are all at odds with each another. Ari and Bini make a difficult life-changing decision. Jasmine hopes that ethical non-monogamy can save her marriage with Gino. Julia's revelation in family therapy pushes Brandon to his limit.

videos.title: The Last Insult
videos.overview: Darcey gets a call that threatens Stacey and Florian's relationship. Jasmine gives Gino an ultimatum to be intimate or agree to an open marriage. Brandon skips a group outing, and Julia feels unsupported. The other couples try to move forward.

videos.title: Last Time Asking
videos.overview: Gino reluctantly considers an open marriage with Jasmine. Brandon is ready to leave the resort after Julia's latest revelation. Stacey confronts Florian about alleged cheating. The couples are tasked with coming up with bandages to fix their issues.

videos.title: The Last Frontier
videos.overview: The final group therapy session magnifies some couples progress and reveals other couples' issues. Natalie and Josh make a life-changing decision. Stacey struggles to trust Florian. Gino and Jasmine make a big decision.

videos.title: Peace At Last
videos.overview: Gino talks to the man Jasmine wants to bring into their marriage. Florian and Gino come to blows at the bar. Julia gives Brandon an ultimatum. Some couples renew their vows and others part ways at the recommitment ceremony.

videos.title: Tell All, Part 1
videos.overview: The couples reunite to share exclusive updates on where their relationships stand since the resort. Jasmine stuns the group with the news of her pregnancy. Things get explosive when Rob doesn't hold back his opinions.

videos.title: Tell All, Part 2
videos.overview: The couples reunite in New York City to share how their relationships have progressed since the retreat; Brandon braces himself to face the truth, Rob and Sophie are at a crossroads, and Stacey reveals news about her relationship.

videos.title: Tell All, Part 3
videos.overview: Florian tries to justify his late-night dalliances with another woman but the cast is not buying it. Ari's mom, Janice, reveals the real story on why Ari kept Bini's passwords. And Josh comes clean on why Natalie has never been invited to his home.

videos.title: Tell All, Part 4
videos.overview: The cast explores why some of the couples have chosen to go their separate ways. Josh reveals the real reason he wouldn't invite Natalie to his home. Sophie makes a shocking claim about Rob, and Gino prepares to confront Matt.

videos.title: Tell All, Part 5
videos.overview: On the shocking finale of The Last Resort Tell All, the cast prepares to dig deep into the details of Gino and Jasmine's open marriage contract, and things become explosive on set between Matt and Gino.

videos.title: Last Chance for a Fairytale
videos.overview: Six couples arrive at a grand castle in the UK to save their marriages. Secrets surface fast as drinking, jealousy, and social media drama explode. One shocking confession in therapy threatens to tear everything apart.

videos.title: Last Crown Standing
videos.overview: Shekinah and Sarper remain distant. Jenny reveals why she doesn't trust Sumit. Rebecca and Zied unravel over control. Kara and Guillermo face painful truths. Patrick and Thais disagree on how to spend their time. Pao questions her future with Russ.

videos.title: How to Make it Last
videos.overview: Kara and Guillermo's fight over her explicit content pushes him to make a big decision, Russ and Pao spiral after a blowout, Patrick and Thais clash over his high sex drive, and Sumit drops a surprising confession in therapy that leaves Jenny stunned.

videos.title: Let Down Your Last Armor
videos.overview: Russ and Pao face brutal intimacy truths; Jenny and Sumit try to reignite desire; Kara hopes their sexual connection brings her and Guillermo back together; Sarper holds a grudge against Rebecca; Patrick and Shekinah clash about money.

videos.title: The Last Chance For Honor
videos.overview: The couples head for a night out, where Rebecca confronts Sarper about comments he made behind her back. Kara and Guillermo reconnect with a sexy dance and get urged to kiss. Thais defends Patrick, and Shekinah's harsh words turn into a screaming match.

videos.title: Fall On Your Last Sword
videos.overview: Sarper and Guillermo clash outside the bar, and Kara is left in tears. The couples head out for a night away at wilderness therapy. They split into three teams, where the couples struggle to communicate as they navigate the harsh environment.

videos.title: The Last Noble Truth
videos.overview: Pao is upset that Russ hasn't done his therapy homework; Patrick reveals new information about Thais' trip to Brazil; sumit confesses why he and Jenny can't move out; Shekinah interrupts Rebecca, which sparks a huge fight between Rebecca and Zied.

videos.title: The Last Leap of Faith
videos.overview: Tension amongst the couples reach new heights at wilderness therapy; Guillermo draws a line in the sand with Kara; Pao is tired of waiting for Russ to be the man she wants; Shekinah and Sarper get exiled from the group.

videos.title: The Last Performance
videos.overview: Jenny questions Sumit's commitment to their marriage. Patrick and Thais take a pregnancy test. Kara and Guillermo grow closer. Russ and Pao celebrate their anniversary with disastrous results. Shekinah and Sarper go to battle with the other couples.

videos.title: The Last Draw
videos.overview: Thais addresses her family drama with a puppet show. Guillermo opens up about Kara's drinking. Shekinah refuses to perform and walks out with Sarper. Zied's puppet show spirals into a blowout with Rebecca. Russ and Pao's anniversary ends in tears.

videos.title: The Last Knight Standing
videos.overview: Pao reels after fighting Russ. Jenny struggles with Sumit's lies. Sarper and Shekinah's marriage hangs by a thread. Zied's demands push Rebecca to her limit. Kara and Guillermo's date ends in disaster. Patrick and Thais face explosive family therapy.
